scope: Original eight-voice moving-window guest on physical N64 with the regular renderer. Same 40 frames and APU clock 21 with frameskip 0. Complete DSP execution remains on the R4300.
method: The controller catches up for ENVX, OUTX or ENDX only if a publishing phase can run in the pending window. Otherwise report the latest visible CPU write (clear for ENDX) or DSP value. Preserve all chronological work for the next flush.

host.coverage: 32 phase starts, 17 output registers, 41 window lengths, with and without interleaved register and RAM writes at the same numeric address.

native.echo_limit: The frame 88 pause does not force DSP catch-up. One fewer echo word has been published at that boundary. Native echo equivalence at a drained DSP boundary remains open.

open: Complete compact accelerated implementation with an explicit layout and an exact deadline path while the renderer owns SP.
Native full-width echo, RAM and fetch equivalence including a drained boundary; general workload coverage and native Mode 7.
